# Webhooks

Manage webhooks for real-time event notifications in Teamleader Focus.

```php
Teamleader::webhooks()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\Other\Webhooks` |
| Create / update / delete | — / — / — |
| Pagination | No |

## Endpoints

- `webhooks.list`
- `webhooks.register`
- `webhooks.unregister`

## Filters

`list()` takes no filters.

## Methods

### `list()`

```php
list(array $filters = [], array $options = []): array
```

List all registered webhooks
Webhooks are returned ordered by URL

`webhooks.list` takes no request body — no filter, page or sort parameter
exists for it. Arguments are rejected rather than discarded.

- `$filters` — Must be empty — this endpoint accepts no filters
- `$options` — Must be empty — this endpoint accepts no sorting or pagination

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` When any argument is passed

### `register()`

```php
register(string $url, array $types): array
```

Register a new webhook

Webhooks are not a complete record of changes: `subscription.updated`,
for one, fires for the subscription's own fields but not for its lines.
Pair them with a periodic re-sync.

- `$url` — Your webhook URL (must be a valid HTTPS URL)
- `$types` — Array of event types that should trigger this webhook

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`

### `unregister()`

```php
unregister(string $url, array $types): array
```

Unregister a webhook
Removes the specified event types from the webhook URL

- `$url` — Your webhook URL
- `$types` — Array of event types to unregister

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`

## Examples

Get all registered webhooks:

```php
$webhooks = Teamleader::webhooks()->list();
```

Register a webhook for a single event type:

```php
$result = Teamleader::webhooks()->register(
                "https://example.com/webhook",
                ["invoice.booked"]
            );
```

Register a webhook for multiple event types:

```php
$result = Teamleader::webhooks()->register(
                "https://example.com/webhook",
                [
                    "invoice.booked",
                    "invoice.sent",
                    "invoice.paymentRegistered"
                ]
            );
```

Register a webhook for all invoice-related events:

```php
$types = Teamleader::webhooks()->getInvoiceEventTypes();
            $result = Teamleader::webhooks()->register("https://example.com/webhook", $types);
```

Unregister specific event types from a webhook:

```php
$result = Teamleader::webhooks()->unregister(
                "https://example.com/webhook",
                ["invoice.booked"]
            );
```

Unregister all events for a webhook URL:

```php
$webhooks = Teamleader::webhooks()->list();
            $url = "https://example.com/webhook";
            $types = [];
            foreach ($webhooks["data"] as $webhook) {
                if ($webhook["url"] === $url) {
                    $types = $webhook["types"];
                    break;
                }
            }
            $result = Teamleader::webhooks()->unregister($url, $types);
```

Get event types for a specific category:

```php
$contactEvents = Teamleader::webhooks()->getEventTypesByCategory("contact");
            $dealEvents = Teamleader::webhooks()->getEventTypesByCategory("deal");
```
